# Studio statement contract fixture

`studio-session.json` was generated by running `XapiRuntime` from
[Praxity/studio at 880a77b9](https://github.com/Praxity/studio/blob/880a77b9c5ae047c5a5a8155250f507ef31f5a73/packages/export-pipeline/src/scorm/api/xapi.ts).
It contains the output of `initialize`, `trackPageVisit`, `trackNavigation`,
two `trackInteraction` calls (scored and ungraded), and `setCompletion`
after `setScore`. Only UUIDs and timestamps are replaced with fixed values.

To reproduce it with Proof's development dependencies installed:

```sh
node test/fixtures/generate-studio.mjs <Studio-checkout>
```

The generator reads the pinned commit through Git, bundles the actual runtime
and its dependencies in memory, and captures `sendStatement` output instead
of making network requests. It does not change the Studio checkout or require
Studio dependencies. `studio-roundtrip.test.ts` posts this fixture to Proof's
ingest endpoint and checks storage reports and the summary API. It also
checks old page rows with empty step columns and anonymous metadata filtering.
